preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n <= 2000 for n, a, _ in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 2000, and a is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= min(26, a) for _, _, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, b is between 1 and the minimum of 26 and a.
The total sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for s, n, _, _ in zip(output, *test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output string s has a length equal to the corresponding n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set(s[l:l+a])) == b for l in range(n-a+1)) for s, n, a, b in zip(output, *test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each substring of length a in s contains exactly b distinct letters.
